workflows.title: Flux2 Klein 4B Edit
workflows.purpose: Edit an image from an instruction
workflows.description: Edit an image from an instruction

inputs.name: source_image
inputs.description: Media input: a data URI, an http(s) URL, or a gateway asset or video reference. The picture you want to change.
inputs.help: The picture you want to change.
inputs.label: a picture to change

inputs.name: mask
inputs.description: Media input: a data URI, an http(s) URL, or a gateway asset or video reference. White areas change; black areas stay as they are.
inputs.help: White areas change; black areas stay as they are.
inputs.label: a mask

inputs.name: denoise
inputs.description: Amount of denoising applied by truncating the Flux2 sigma schedule. Lower values preserve more input-image structure.

form.prompt: A small teal fish mark on a clean white card.

example_request.curl:
curl '/v1/images/edits' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer '$AZIZAM_API_KEY \
  -F 'model=flux2-klein-4b' \
  -F 'prompt=A small teal fish mark on a clean white card.' \
  -F 'size=64x64' \
  -F 'extensions={"com.azizam.workflow":{"steps":1,"guidance":0.0,"denoise":1}}' \
  -F 'image=@./source-image.png' \
  -F 'mask=@./mask.png' \
  --output workflow-output.bin
example_request.python:
import os
from contextlib import ExitStack
import requests

with ExitStack() as stack:
    files = {
    'image': stack.enter_context(open('./source-image.png', 'rb')),
    'mask': stack.enter_context(open('./mask.png', 'rb')),
    }
    response = requests.request('POST', '/v1/images/edits',
        headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ.get('AZIZAM_API_KEY') or ''}"},
        data={'model': 'flux2-klein-4b', 'prompt': 'A small teal fish mark on a clean white card.', 'size': '64x64', 'extensions': '{"com.azizam.workflow":{"steps":1,"guidance":0.0,"denoise":1}}'}, files=files, timeout=300)
response.raise_for_status()
open('workflow-output.bin', 'wb').write(response.content)
